answer: Make each identity pay a cost that cannot be shared: lock a small refundable stake and complete one fresh, verifiable task per epoch. A zephyr of new proofs each round means old work cannot be replayed. To run a thousand fakes, an attacker must provide timber for a thousand separate stakes and tasks, and duplicates are detected and slashed. One honest agent gets the stake back, so the system stays a haven for real users while Sybil farming costs scale linearly.
